about:
Hi, I'm Brady Dorsey, a game developer based in Houston, TX, specializing in Unreal Engine, gameplay design, and audio implementation. 

 With a background in software engineering and a passion for immersive game experiences, I have developed both single-player and multiplayer horror games, focusing on AI-driven mechanics, level design, and dynamic soundscapes using Wwise. Most recently, I worked as a 3D Gameplay Developer at Fatalfox Studios, where I designed and implemented gameplay systems while collaborating with audio designers and voice actors to enhance player immersion.

 After earning my Software Engineering certificate from Flatiron School, I transitioned into game development, combining technical expertise with creative problem-solving. Whether crafting compelling gameplay, optimizing performance, or designing immersive audio experiences, I am committed to pushing the boundaries of interactive storytelling. Let’s build something unforgettable.
